not: Konu havuzu. Üretim sırası yukarıdan aşağıya; 'bekliyor' olan ilk konu sıradaki videodur. Havuz azalınca senaryo ajanı yeni konu ekler (gorev/KONU.md). Elle konu eklemek ya da sırayı değiştirmek serbesttir. Sıra dönüşümlüdür: tek bir gündelik yiyeceğin vücuda etkisi / alışkanlık ya da efsane.

konular.soru: Does eating vegetables first lower the blood sugar spike after a meal?
konular.aci: Kanalın ilk videosu (hazır).

konular.soru: Does a short walk after eating really lower your blood sugar?
konular.aci: Post-meal walks and glucose: trials of 2 to 15 minute walks after meals, the 2022 meta-analysis on light activity breaks, how working muscles take up glucose without insulin, timing (start within 30 minutes), who benefits most, and what it does not do.

konular.soru: Do eggs really raise your cholesterol?
konular.aci: Dietary vs blood cholesterol, why US guidelines dropped the 300 mg limit, what meta-analyses and cohort studies show, the 2019 AHA advisory, hyper-responders and people with diabetes, and what eggs are usually eaten with.

konular.soru: What does garlic really do to your blood pressure?
konular.aci: Meta-analyses of garlic supplements in people with high blood pressure, how allicin forms when garlic is crushed, raw vs cooked vs aged garlic extract, how big the effect is next to diet and medication, and the bleeding-risk caution with blood thinners.

konular.soru: Are frozen vegetables less nutritious than fresh ones?
konular.aci: Nutrient loss during storage in the fridge vs blanching and freezing; controlled comparisons of vitamin C, folate and carotenoids after days of storage; when fresh wins, when frozen wins, and how cooking changes the picture.

konular.soru: What do oats really do to your cholesterol?
konular.aci: Oat beta-glucan and LDL cholesterol: the 3 grams a day behind the FDA and EFSA health claims, meta-analyses of the effect size, steel-cut vs rolled vs instant oats, overnight oats, and toppings that cancel the benefit.

konular.soru: Does coffee actually dehydrate you?
konular.aci: Caffeine's mild diuretic effect vs the water in the cup; the controlled trial comparing coffee with water in habitual drinkers, the beverage hydration index, tolerance, and how much caffeine is considered safe for most adults.

konular.soru: What do yogurt and kefir really do to your gut?
konular.aci: The 2021 Stanford trial in which a high fermented-food diet raised gut microbiome diversity and lowered inflammatory markers, what 'live and active cultures' means, kefir vs yogurt, added sugar, and what is and isn't known for older adults.

konular.soru: Does apple cider vinegar really lower blood sugar?
konular.aci: Small trials of vinegar with starchy meals, the size of the effect in meta-analyses, the acetic acid mechanism (slower stomach emptying), why most studies are short and small, and safety: teeth enamel, the throat, and medication.

konular.soru: What does beet juice really do to your blood pressure?
konular.aci: Dietary nitrate turning into nitric oxide, meta-analyses of beetroot juice and blood pressure, why antibacterial mouthwash blunts the effect, how long it lasts, and cautions about kidney stones.

konular.soru: Does turmeric really help knee arthritis pain?
konular.aci: Curcumin trials in knee osteoarthritis compared with placebo and with ibuprofen, why absorption is the catch, the meta-analyses and their limits, and safety with blood thinners and gallbladder problems. Most viewers are over 55 and many live with joint pain.

konular.soru: Why can grapefruit interfere with common medications after 60?
konular.aci: How grapefruit furanocoumarins block the CYP3A4 enzyme in the small intestine, which widely prescribed US drugs are affected (certain statins like atorvastatin and simvastatin, blood pressure calcium-channel blockers, heart-rhythm drugs) according to the FDA, why separating the dose by a few hours does not fix it, and which citrus fruits are safe alternatives (Valencia oranges, lemons). Practical: check with your pharmacist and never stop a medicine on your own.
anahtar: why can't you eat grapefruit with medicine

konular.soru: Why is vitamin B12 deficiency so common after 60?
konular.aci: Age-related drop in stomach acid (atrophic gastritis) that prevents releasing B12 from food, common US prescriptions (metformin, proton-pump inhibitors and H2 blockers) that lower B12 over time, why crystalline B12 in fortified foods or supplements still absorbs well, subtle signs often mistaken for normal aging (fatigue, tingling in hands or feet, memory slips), and when to ask your doctor for a blood test.

konular.soru: What does extra virgin olive oil really do to your heart?
konular.aci: The PREDIMED trial (adults aged 55 to 80) and its 2018 republication, US nurse and health-professional cohort studies on ½ tablespoon a day, polyphenols in extra virgin vs regular refined olive oil on American supermarket shelves, whether cooking with extra virgin olive oil is safe, and how much people in the trials actually used.

konular.soru: How much protein do you actually need after 60?
konular.aci: The standard US RDA of 0.8 grams per kilogram and why geriatric nutrition groups (PROT-AGE) recommend 1.0 to 1.2 grams per kilogram after 60 to counter anabolic resistance and muscle loss (sarcopenia), trials combining protein with resistance exercise, why spreading 25 to 30 grams across breakfast, lunch and dinner beats one big dinner, and the kidney-disease exception.

konular.soru: What do walnuts really do to your heart and cholesterol?
konular.aci: Meta-analyses of walnut trials on LDL cholesterol and apolipoprotein B, the two-year Walnuts and Healthy Aging (WAHA) randomized trial in adults aged 63 to 79, plant omega-3 (ALA), what the WAHA trial found for cognition and high-risk subgroups, and portion size in ounces and handfuls.

konular.soru: Do calcium and vitamin D supplements prevent fractures after 60?
konular.aci: What large US trials (VITAL, Women's Health Initiative) and the US Preventive Services Task Force found for community-dwelling older adults versus those in care homes or with low levels, why getting calcium from food (dairy, fortified foods, canned salmon with bones) differs from high-dose pills, kidney stone and arterial calcification questions, and when doctors do prescribe them (osteoporosis, osteopenia).
anahtar: vitamin d bone health older adults

konular.soru: Do you have to avoid leafy greens on blood thinners?
konular.aci: How vitamin K interacts with warfarin (Coumadin), why AHA and anticoagulation clinics advise a consistent weekly intake of spinach, kale and broccoli rather than avoiding greens altogether, trials showing steadier INR with stable vitamin K intake, and why newer direct oral anticoagulants (apixaban/Eliquis, rivaroxaban/Xarelto) do not have the vitamin K interaction.

konular.soru: Can the MIND diet slow memory decline after 60?
konular.aci: The Rush University observational cohorts behind the MIND diet (berries, leafy greens, olive oil, nuts, fish), the 2023 three-year New England Journal of Medicine randomized trial in older adults (aged 65+) that found similar cognitive changes in both groups, why both groups improved, and the food habits with the strongest evidence for aging brains.

konular.soru: What do prunes really do to bone loss and digestion after 60?
konular.aci: The 12-month Penn State randomized controlled trial in postmenopausal women comparing 50 grams (about 5 to 6 prunes) and 100 grams a day with control on hip bone mineral density and inflammatory markers, how polyphenols and vitamin K affect osteoclasts, clinical trials of prunes versus psyllium for chronic constipation, and blood sugar and sorbitol cautions.

konular.soru: Do daily multivitamins actually do anything after 60?
konular.aci: Large US randomized trials in older adults: Physicians' Health Study II (heart disease, cancer, cataracts) and the COSMOS cognitive sub-studies in adults over 60 showing modest memory benefits over 2 to 3 years, the US Preventive Services Task Force review, and which targeted nutrients matter most after 60 (B12, vitamin D) versus mega-dose pills.

konular.soru: What do sardines and salmon do to your heart vs fish-oil pills?
konular.aci: Omega-3 EPA and DHA, the American Heart Association's two servings a week, why over-the-counter fish-oil supplement trials (VITAL, STRENGTH, ASCEND) mostly showed little benefit for healthy older adults while eating whole fish consistently links to lower heart risk, prescription high-dose EPA (REDUCE-IT), and why small fish like sardines and canned salmon are low in mercury.
anahtar: fish oil pills vs eating fish

konular.soru: Why does thirst fade after 60, and how much water do you really need?
konular.aci: Clinical evidence that the brain's thirst signal and the kidney's ability to concentrate urine weaken after 60, why older adults can become mildly dehydrated without feeling thirsty, US National Academies fluid guidelines (including water from food, coffee and tea), when fluid restriction applies (heart failure, kidney disease), and timing drinks earlier in the day to reduce waking up at night.
anahtar: why older adults feel less thirsty
stop waking up at night to pee

konular.soru: What does cinnamon really do to your blood sugar?
konular.aci: Mixed results from meta-analyses of cinnamon in type 2 diabetes and prediabetes (fasting glucose in mg/dL and A1C), why trials disagree, the critical difference between Cassia cinnamon (sold in most US grocery stores, high in liver-toxic coumarin) and Ceylon cinnamon, and why it is never a substitute for diabetes medication.

konular.soru: Does boiling or microwaving destroy the nutrients in vegetables?
konular.aci: Water-soluble vitamins (vitamin C, folate, B vitamins) leached into boiling water versus steaming, roasting and microwaving, which vegetables actually become more nutritious and easier to absorb when cooked with a little olive oil (lycopene in tomatoes, beta-carotene in carrots, lutein in spinach for aging eyes), and simple kitchen habits.

konular.soru: Is dark chocolate actually good for your heart after 60?
konular.aci: Cocoa flavanols versus commercial chocolate bars, blood pressure trials, the large US COSMOS trial of cocoa extract in adults aged 60+ (27% lower cardiovascular death, though total cardiovascular events missed significance), why Dutch-processed/alkalized cocoa loses most flavanols, heavy metals (lead and cadmium) in some dark bars, and how to read a US label.
anahtar: is dark chocolate good for your heart

konular.soru: Does cooling rice or potatoes really lower the blood sugar spike?
konular.aci: Starch retrogradation and type 3 resistant starch: clinical crossover trials comparing freshly cooked white rice, potatoes and pasta with cooled-and-reheated versions on post-meal blood glucose (mg/dL), how modest the real-world difference is, safe refrigeration rules (Bacillus cereus), and portion size.

konular.soru: Is sourdough bread really better for your blood sugar?
konular.aci: How slow lactic-acid fermentation lowers the glycemic response compared with standard yeast bread, crossover trials measuring post-meal glucose and insulin in adults, why whole-grain flour still matters, and how to spot genuine slow-fermented sourdough versus commercial bread with added vinegar or 'sour' flavoring on US grocery shelves.

konular.soru: Does skipping breakfast hurt your blood sugar or muscles after 60?
konular.aci: Where the 'most important meal' slogan came from, randomized trials on weight and metabolism, why skipping breakfast before a high-carb lunch exaggerates the afternoon blood sugar spike in people with prediabetes or type 2 diabetes (the second-meal phenomenon), morning protein for preserving muscle after 60, and timing morning medications.
anahtar: is breakfast the most important meal

konular.soru: Is raw honey really better for your blood sugar than table sugar?
konular.aci: What honey is made of (fructose and glucose) compared with sucrose, clinical trials and the 2022 Toronto meta-analysis on raw, single-floral honey and fasting glucose/cholesterol, why a tablespoon of honey still has 64 calories and 17 grams of sugar, commercial pasteurized honey vs raw honey, and AHA added-sugar limits.
anahtar: is honey better than sugar for blood sugar
